artifact: Implemented src/slugify.js — `npm test`'s 7 slugify tests now pass (7/7, `node --test test/slugify.test.js`, 0 fail). Approach: NFD-normalize and strip Unicode marks (`\p{M}`) to remove accents, lowercase, replace every non-`[a-z0-9]` run with one dash, trim leading/trailing dashes. For `maxLength`: return early if the slug already fits; otherwise cut hard at maxLength and, if the cut contains a dash, back up to the last dash (so "The quick brown fox" @10 → "the-quick"); no dash in the cut means a hard cut ("Supercalifragilistic" @5 → "super"). Empty/separator-only input → "". Tests were not modified. File is final; other bots can ignore src/slugify.js.
